sections.title: Cover Letter
sections.content: We are honored to propose a partnership with the City of Carbondale. Our team will deliver a clear brand platform, practical creative assets, and a measured rollout plan that respects municipal procurement requirements.

sections.title: Approach
sections.content: Discovery workshops establish audience priorities and civic constraints. Creative development then translates those insights into a coherent visual and verbal system. Implementation includes templates, training, and a 90-day adoption calendar so staff can apply the brand consistently.

sections.title: Key Personnel
sections.content: Maya Chen serves as Account Director with 12 years of municipal brand experience. Jordan Hale leads design with 9 years across civic and destination work. Their roles remain consistent throughout this manuscript: Maya owns client communications; Jordan owns design quality.

sections.title: References
sections.content: References include three completed municipal brand engagements with permission to contact. Staff biographies and curricula vitae are enclosed in Appendix B.
